title.narrative: Scaling up cholera response across Yemen

description.narrative: 1- Reducing deaths among children and pregnant women 2- Reducing deaths among Yemeni citizens 3- Reducing the spread of the epidemic to non-epidemic governorates 4- Supporting the steadfastness of the Ministry of Health and the Yemeni population in confronting epidemics and community diseases

A set of activities aimed at reducing the spread of cholera through a set of preventive and therapeutic activities. The project includes securing vaccines, medicines and medical supplies for central laboratories, in addition to personal protective equipment for medical personnel. The project activities also include paying the operating budgets for vaccination campaigns and rapid response teams, in addition to epidemiological investigation activities. The project also includes supporting essential activities in the water and environmental sanitation sectors, as these activities play a crucial role in reducing the spread of the epidemic. The project will provide the necessary medicines, intravenous solutions and supplies to treat confirmed cases in all Yemeni governorates.

The multi-sectoral response, coordinated by WHO, the Ministry of Public Health and Population and the Centre, includes a range of preventive and curative activities in the health, water, sanitation and hygiene sectors, aiming to reduce avoidable mortality and morbidity rates from cholera/acute watery diarrhea, as well as prevent and control the spread of cholera cases among affected communities in Yemen.
